lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਰਮਾਰਥੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਖਚਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur prasaad paaeeai paramaarath satasa(n)gat setee man khachanaa ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, the greatest thing is obtained, and the mind is involved with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀਆ ਖੇਲੁ ਬਡ ਮੇਲੁ ਤਮਾਸਾ ਵਾਹਗੁਰੂ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਰਚਨਾ ॥੩॥੧੩॥੪੨॥
lines.transliteration: keeaa khel bad mel tamaasaa vaahaguroo teree sabh rachanaa ||3||13||42||
lines.translation: You have formed and created this play, this great game. O Waahay Guru, this is all Your making. ||3||13||42||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਨੰਤੁ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਆਦਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: agam ana(n)t anaad aad jis koi na jaanai ||
lines.translation: The Lord is Inaccessible, Infinite, Eternal and Primordial; no one knows His beginning.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਬਿਰੰਚਿ ਧਰਿ ਧੵਾਨੁ ਨਿਤਹਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਬੇਦੁ ਬਖਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: siv bira(n)ch dhar dhyaan nitahi jis bed bakhaanai ||
lines.translation: Shiva and Brahma meditate on Him; the Vedas describe Him again and again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਸਰ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: nira(n)kaar niravair avar nahee doosar koee ||
lines.translation: The Lord is Formless, beyond hate and vengeance; there is no one else like Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੰਜਨ ਗੜ੍ਹਣ ਸਮਥੁ ਤਰਣ ਤਾਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bha(n)jan gaRhan samath taran taaran prabh soee ||
lines.translation: He creates and destroys - He is All-powerful; God is the Boat to carry all across.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਕੀਓ ਜਨੁ ਮਥੁਰਾ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanaa prakaar jin jag keeo jan mathuraa rasanaa rasai ||
lines.translation: He created the world in its various aspects; His humble servant Mat'huraa delights in His Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਚਿਤਹ ਬਸੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sree sat naam karataa purakh gur raamadaas chitah basai ||1||
lines.translation: Sat Naam, the Great and Supreme True Name of God, the Personification of Creativity, dwells in the Consciousness of Guru Raam Daas. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਗਹਿ ਕਰੀਆ ਧ੍ਰੁਵ ਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਸਮ੍ਹਾਰਨ ਕਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: guroo samarath gahi kareeaa dhruv budh sumat samhaaran kau ||
lines.translation: I have grasped hold of the All-powerful Guru; He has made my mind steady and stable, and embellished me with clear consciousness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫੁਨਿ ਧ੍ਰੰਮ ਧੁਜਾ ਫਹਰੰਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਅਘ ਪੁੰਜ ਤਰੰਗ ਨਿਵਾਰਨ ਕਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: phun dhra(n)m dhujaa phahara(n)t sadaa agh pu(n)j tara(n)g nivaaran kau ||
lines.translation: And, His Banner of Righteousness waves proudly forever, to defend against the waves of sin.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਥੁਰਾ ਜਨ ਜਾਨਿ ਕਹੀ ਜੀਅ ਸਾਚੁ ਸੁ ਅਉਰ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਬਿਚਾਰਨ ਕਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mathuraa jan jaan kahee jee saach s aur kachhoo na bichaaran kau ||
lines.translation: His humble servant Mat'hraa knows this as true, and speaks it from his soul; there is nothing else to consider.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਬਡੌ ਕਲਿ ਮੈ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਨ ਕਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har naam bohith badau kal mai bhav saagar paar utaaran kau ||2||
lines.translation: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Lord's Name is the Great Ship, to carry us all across the terrifying world-ocean, safely to the other side. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਤ ਹੀ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਗ ਸੁਰੰਗ ਰਤੇ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਤ ਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tat hee satasa(n)gat sa(n)g sura(n)g rate jas gaavat hai ||
lines.translation: The Saints dwell in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; imbued with pure celestial love, they sing the Lord's Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਮ ਪੰਥੁ ਧਰਿਓ ਧਰਨੀਧਰ ਆਪਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਧਾਰਿ ਨ ਧਾਵਤ ਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhram pa(n)th dhario dharaneedhar aap rahe liv dhaar na dhaavat hai ||
lines.translation: The Support of the Earth has established this Path of Dharma; He Himself remains lovingly attuned to the Lord, and does not wander in distraction.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਥੁਰਾ ਭਨਿ ਭਾਗ ਭਲੇ ਉਨੑ ਕੇ ਮਨ ਇਛਤ ਹੀ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਤ ਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mathuraa bhan bhaag bhale unh ke man ichhat hee phal paavat hai ||
lines.translation: So speaks Mat'huraa: those blessed with good fortune receive the fruits of their minds' desires.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਵਿ ਕੇ ਸੁਤ ਕੋ ਤਿਨੑ ਤ੍ਰਾਸੁ ਕਹਾ ਜੁ ਚਰੰਨ ਗੁਰੂ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਤ ਹੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: rav ke sut ko tinh traas kahaa j chara(n)n guroo chit laavat hai ||3||
lines.translation: Those who focus their consciousness on the Guru's Feet, they do not fear the judgement of Dharamraj. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਧਾ ਪਰਪੂਰਨ ਸਬਦ ਤਰੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਤ ਦਿਨ ਆਗਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: niramal naam sudhaa parapooran sabad tara(n)g pragatit din aagar ||
lines.translation: The Immaculate, Sacred Pool of the Guru is overflowing with the waves of the Shabad, radiantly revealed in the early hours before the dawn.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ਅਥਾਹ ਅਤਿ ਬਡ ਸੁਭਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਰਤਨਾਗਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gahir ga(n)bheer athaah at bad subhar sadaa sabh bidh ratanaagar ||
lines.translation: He is Deep and Profound, Unfathomable and utterly Great, eternally overflowing with all sorts of jewels.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਮਰਾਲ ਕਰਹਿ ਕੰਤੂਹਲ ਤਿਨ ਜਮ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਗਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t maraal karahi ka(n)toohal tin jam traas mitio dukh kaagar ||
lines.translation: The Saint-swans celebrate; their fear of death is erased, along with the accounts of their pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਜੁਗ ਦੁਰਤ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਬੇ ਕਉ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਗਲ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: kalajug durat door karabe kau darasan guroo sagal sukh saagar ||4||
lines.translation: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the sins are taken away; the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan is the Ocean of all peace and comfort. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਮੁਨਿ ਧੵਾਨੁ ਧਰੈ ਫਿਰਤ ਸਗਲ ਜੁਗ ਕਬਹੁ ਕ ਕੋਊ ਪਾਵੈ ਆਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਕਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau mun dhyaan dharai phirat sagal jug kabahu ka kooo paavai aatam pragaas kau ||
lines.translation: For His Sake, the silent sages meditated and focused their consciousness, wandering all the ages through; rarely, if ever, their souls were enlightened.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਹਿਤ ਬਿਰੰਚਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਸਿਵ ਮੁਨਿ ਗਹਿ ਨ ਤਜਾਤ ਕਬਿਲਾਸ ਕੰਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bed baanee sahit bira(n)ch jas gaavai jaa ko siv mun gahi na tajaat kabilaas ka(n)u ||
lines.translation: In the Hymns of the Vedas, Brahma sang His Praises; for His Sake, Shiva the silent sage held his place on the Kailaash Mountain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੌ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤੀ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਤਪ ਜਟਾ ਜੂਟ ਭੇਖ ਕੀਏ ਫਿਰਤ ਉਦਾਸ ਕਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau jogee jatee sidh saadhik anek tap jataa joot bhekh keee phirat udaas kau ||
lines.translation: For His Sake, the Yogis, celibates, Siddhas and seekers, the countless sects of fanatics with matted hair wear religious robes, wandering as detached renunciates.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਭਾਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਬਡਾਈ ਦਈ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਕਉ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: s tin satigur sukh bhaai kripaa dhaaree jee naam kee badaaee daee gur raamadaas kau ||5||
lines.translation: That True Guru, by the Pleasure of His Will, showered His Mercy upon all beings, and blessed Guru Raam Daas with the Glorious Greatness of the Naam. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਧਿਆਨ ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਤੇਜ ਪੁੰਜ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਗ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam nidhaan dhiaan a(n)taragat tej pu(n)j tihu log pragaase ||
lines.translation: He focuses His Meditation deep within; the Embodiment of Light, He illuminates the three worlds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਤ ਦਰਸੁ ਭਟਕਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਜਤ ਦੁਖ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਬਿਗਾਸੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dekhat daras bhatak bhram bhajat dukh parahar sukh sahaj bigaase ||
lines.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, doubt runs away, pain is eradicated, and celestial peace spontaneously wells up.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਸਿਖ ਸਦਾ ਅਤਿ ਲੁਭਿਤ ਅਲਿ ਸਮੂਹ ਜਿਉ ਕੁਸਮ ਸੁਬਾਸੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sevak sikh sadaa at lubhit al samooh jiu kusam subaase ||
lines.translation: The selfless servants and Sikhs are always totally captivated by it, like bumble bees lured by the fragrance of the flower.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਦੵਮਾਨ ਗੁਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਥਪੵਉ ਥਿਰੁ ਸਾਚਉ ਤਖਤੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੈ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: bidymaan gur aap thapy thir saachau takhat guroo raamadaasai ||6||
lines.translation: The Guru Himself established the Eternal Throne of Truth, in Guru Raam Daas. ||6||
